A Date year setter is a time/date operation; it is not an object-member assignment. Receiver binding should also be checked separately.
Array.Reverse operates on an array. The generic manipulation bucket loses the receiver/operation distinction required by TAXONOMY.
A method spelled replace may replace a string, rename a filesystem path, or implement unrelated behavior. The matcher lacks receiver/type binding. Its present evidence is call syntax.

screening.note: data/source is closed to additions and has migration backlog. Existing legacy placement is not by itself a new-admission violation. Each rule still needs an evidence-based destination.

negative_checks.note: The ten primitive collisions have different scopes or additional constraints; none was classified as a confirmed duplicate from this screen.

migration_requirements: Preserve each matcher and effective scope before separate detection corrections.
Audit exact and ancestor-directory references, negative consumers, near/proximity consumers, and needs thresholds.
Do not demote complete observations to hide incorrect placement.
Do not migrate genuine calls, flow-bound transformations or explicit operations merely because the matcher uses text.
